BM25 filter keeps only pages relevant to the query

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const crawlberg = @import("crawlberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try crawlberg.crawl("{\"bm25_query\":\"rust programming language\",\"bm25_threshold\":0.1,\"content_filter\":\"bm25\",\"max_depth\":1}", "https://example.com");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
